text: Added type-directed SliceSampling: nearest is generic; linear and cubic are Double-only. SlicePlan reduces world-to-voxel mapping to primitive affine increments with one row-major output allocation, and ResamplingPlan now shares the same kernels. Analytic affine-field, label, outside, mirroring, oblique affine-step, mismatch, and parity suites pass JVM+JS (178 JVM, 173 JS).
